replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
I think it would be better without the parkour leading from spawn to the outer pathway. Mainly because it could influence team spleefing. 
As I see it, the pyramid still looks a bit bland, making try mixing cobblestone/stone stairs? Or add some designs to it if possible. Judging from the amount of void and size of the pathways, diamonds wouldn't work too well.

Also, if you can, try to add something that makes the map stand out from the rest, whether it be adding more islands or adding an "objective" in mid (something that allows a team to get an advantage, but not too much of one). Try not to add any OP bows if you're going to add an objective of some sort.

Anyways, looks good so far! Nice work.
